entries.en: WNS News has been notified of a breaking story. Saburo Arasaka lives once more, though now in the body of his son.
entries.ro: WNS News a primit o știre de ultimă oră. Saburo Arasaka e iar în viață, dar acum în corpul fiului lui.

entries.en: The CEO was reported dead months ago, but now it's been revealed that a copy of his consciousness was made before his death.
entries.ro: CEO-ul fusese dat mort acum câteva luni, dar acum s-a aflat că o copie a conștiinței lui fusese făcută înainte să moară.

entries.en: It appears his consciousness was used to overwrite that of his son and heir, Yorinobu Arasaka. This shocking development was revealed at a press conference earlier today.
entries.ro: Se pare că i s-a folosit conștiința ca să-i rescrie pe cea a fiului și moștenitorului, Yorinobu Arasaka. Chestia asta șocantă a fost anunțată la o conferință de presă mai devreme azi.

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="皆さん、いらっしゃい" t="Welcome, everyone." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="皆さん、いらっしゃい" t="Bun venit, tuturor." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: Today is truly a historic day. Today, technology has fulfilled the promise left empty by religion.
entries.ro: Azi e chiar o zi istorică. Tehnologia a împlinit ce religia a promis și n-a făcut.

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="祖父はよく、「枯れ落ちた花は枝に戻らない」と言っていました" t="My grandfather once told me, \"A fallen flower cannot return to its branch.\" " b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="祖父はよく、「枯れ落ちた花は枝に戻らない」と言っていました" t="Bunicul meu mi-a spus odată: „O floare căzută nu se poate întoarce pe ramură.”" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="人は誰も、物心ついた瞬間から、死を恐れるものです" t="From the moment a person becomes conscious of their being, they live in fear of death." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="人は誰も、物心ついた瞬間から、死を恐れるものです" t="Din clipa în care omul își dă seama că există, trăiește cu frica de moarte." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="ついに、人類最大の恐怖が克服されました。私、サブロウ・アラサカは今、息子の体を使い、みなさんの前に立っています" t="Mankind's oldest and greatest fear has been overcome. Here before you, I stand now – Saburo Arasaka – alive in the body of my son." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="ついに、人類最大の恐怖が克服されました。私、サブロウ・アラサカは今、息子の体を使い、みなさんの前に立っています" t="Cea mai veche și mai mare frică a omenirii a fost bătută. Iată-mă în fața voastră – Saburo Arasaka – viu, în trupul fiului meu." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="私はかつてヨリノブに生を与えました。彼は愛する父のために、それを返してくれたのです" t="I once gave life to my Yorinobu. In return, he has demonstrated the depth of a son's love and has returned this gift to me." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="私はかつてヨリノブに生を与えました。彼は愛する父のために、それを返してくれたのです" t="Cândva i-am dat viață lui Yorinobu. Iar el, cu dragostea unui fiu, mi-a întors darul ăsta." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="私のいない間、ヨリノブは会社を変革しようといくつかの決定を下しましたが、これらは過ちでした" t="In my absence, Yorinobu made several decisions aimed at transforming our company. In these, he erred." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="私のいない間、ヨリノブは会社を変革しようといくつかの決定を下しましたが、これらは過ちでした" t="Cât am lipsit eu, Yorinobu a luat câteva decizii ca să schimbe compania. În ele a greșit." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="私の指揮のもと、アラサカ社は元の姿を取り戻します。決して揺らぐことのない、強いアラサカが帰ってくることを、約束いたします。" t="Under my leadership, the Arasaka Corporation will return to its roots – roots strong enough to move the heaviest stones." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="私の指揮のもと、アラサカ社は元の姿を取り戻します。決して揺らぐことのない、強いアラサカが帰ってくることを、約束いたします。" t="Sub conducerea mea, Corporația Arasaka o să revină la rădăcini – rădăcini destul de tari ca să mute cele mai grele pietre." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="ご清聴ありがとうございました" t="Thank you." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="ご清聴ありがとうございました" t="Vă mulțumesc." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="サブロウ様、誠におめでとうございます" t="Thank you, Saburo. You are an inspiration." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="サブロウ様、誠におめでとうございます" t="Mulțumesc, Saburo. Ești o inspirație pentru noi." b="" a=""/>
